The [[opening crawl]] of {{GalaxiesAED}} dates the game to after the events of {{Film|IV}}, and additionally, [[Serji-X Arrogantus]], who [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[Star Wars (1977) 10]]&mdash;the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]&mdash;appears in the game. Therefore, at least a portion of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Furthermore, in the game [[Ruwan Tokai]] references the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction of the Death Star]] as having occurred one year earlier, and ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' also places the events of ''Galaxies''{{'}} [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9: "The Fury of Exar Kun"]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Lastly, while [[W:c:swg:Chapter 11|Chapter 11: "The Battle of Echo Base"]] features the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]&mdash;dated to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by ''The New Essential Chronology''&mdash;the developers have [https://www.engadget.com/2008-11-20-the-star-wars-galaxies-devs-on-how-hoth-was-made.html stated] that the portrayal of that battle in the game is intentionally anachronistic. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' must span from 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] to around 1 ABY.<noinclude>
